How to use this book
Answer blanks. Interactive fields from the online test are printed as numbered dotted lines — e.g. 
7
 — write your answer on the line. For multiple-choice questions, tick the box 
next to your choice. 
Listening audio. Every Listening test starts with a QR code. Scan it with your phone camera and the
test audio plays straight in the browser — no app and no login needed. 
Answer sheets. An IELTS-style answer sheet follows each Listening and Reading test. Transfer your
answers there, exactly like on test day. 
Writing & Speaking. Writing tasks include ruled pages sized for 150 / 250-word answers. Speaking
parts are printed with all examiner questions and the Part 2 cue card — practise aloud with a timer. 
Check your answers. Each paper has a "Scan to check" QR code. Listening and Reading open the
answer key online; Writing shows a model answer; Speaking lets you record yourself and get an instant
AI band score. No answer key is printed in this book — scan to see it. 
Check your band online. For instant scoring, band estimates and AI feedback on Writing and
Speaking, take the same tests online at keenielts.com. 
Practice smarter. Score higher. — keenielts.com

Speaking
3 parts · 11–14 minutes · practise aloud, ideally with a partner or recorder
PA RT  1
PART 1
1. What is your name?
PA RT  2
FOLLOW UP QUESTIONS
Is public transportation popular in your country?
What can be done to improve public transport services in your hometown?
What leisure facilities could be used by people of age groups?
Do you think young people in your country like going to the cinema?
How is the subway system developing in your country?
What transportation do you use the most?
You have one minute to prepare. Then speak for 1–2 minutes.
PA RT  3
CUE CARDS
1. Describe a new development in your country or the area where you live (like shopping
centre, park, etc)
- What and where the development is
- What it was like before
- How long it took to complete it
- How people feel about it
